item.title: Cerebrospinal Fluid Flow Waves Decline in the Aging Brain
item.description: Cerebrospinal fluid is manufactured by the choroid plexus, flows through the brain, and drains into the body via the glymphatic system. This current carries away metabolic waste from the brain, particularly during sleep. item.description: When should we consider an age-related condition as being something distinct from aging? item.title: Age-Related Synaptic Dysfunction and Possible Approaches to Treatment
item.description: Dysfunction of the synaptic connections between neurons in the brain is characteristic of aging and exaggerated in neurodegenerative conditions, particularly Alzheimer's disease.
